title.en: An Act to Amend Certain Items in Section One, Republic Act Numbered Two Thousand Ninety-Three

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2446_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Items (m) and (n), for the Province of Leyte, sub-paragraph twenty-three, paragraph a, Title D, section one of Republic Act Numbered Two thousand ninety-three, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(m) San Roque Waterworks, Macrohon ₱5,000.00 "(n) San Isidro Waterworks, Malitbog 20,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
